In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is not one best PSO variant, but rather that the most appropriate variant is the one that best suits the problem to be solved and the available computational resources.
there is no single best variant of the original particle Swarm Optimization (PSO).
the performance of a PSO variant depends on the problem and that there is no best PSO variant.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
it is possible to design PSO algorithms by combining components in a modular way and that such an approach is beneficial.
the PSO algorithm is a very flexible optimization technique and can be easily modified and adapted to a wide range of problems and applications.
PSO is an algorithmic framework rather than a single algorithm.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a component-based analysis and design of PSO algorithms can be very fruitful.
the design of new optimization algorithms can be guided by a systematic empirical study of existing algorithms.
the performance of an optimization algorithm can be significantly improved by combining components of different variants of an optimization algorithm.
